import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(matrix):
    """
    Compute row-wise maxima of a matrix, then return the skewness, kurtosis,
    and histogram Axes of their distribution. A KDE density estimate is
    overlaid on the histogram when possible.
    """
    arr = np.asarray(matrix)

    if arr.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Input matrix must be a 2D array.")
    if arr.size == 0 or arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrix must be non-empty.")

    row_maxima = np.max(arr, axis=1)

    skewness = stats.skew(row_maxima, bias=False, nan_policy="omit")
    kurt = stats.kurtosis(row_maxima, fisher=True, bias=False, nan_policy="omit")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.hist(row_maxima, bins="auto", density=True, alpha=0.7, edgecolor="black")

    # Core density estimate via KDE when the data support it
    finite_vals = row_maxima[np.isfinite(row_maxima)]
    if finite_vals.size >= 2 and np.ptp(finite_vals) > 0:
        try:
            kde = stats.gaussian_kde(finite_vals)
            x_min, x_max = finite_vals.min(), finite_vals.max()
            pad = 0.1 * (x_max - x_min) if x_max > x_min else 1.0
            x_grid = np.linspace(x_min - pad, x_max + pad, 200)
            ax.plot(x_grid, kde(x_grid), color="red", linewidth=2)
        except Exception:
            pass

    ax.set_title("Distribution of Row-wise Maxima")
    ax.set_xlabel("Row maximum")
    ax.set_ylabel("Density")
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    return skewness, kurt, ax
